game.name: factorio
game.description: The Factorio Learning Environment (FLE 0.3.0, Factorio 1.1.110) as a Coworld: each seat gets its own headless Factorio server on the FLE lab map and plays a fixed number of steps, each step a Python program written against the FLE agent API (place_entity, connect_entities, nearest, craft_item, sleep, ...). Open play scores each seat by FLE production score; throughput variants score by achieved items/minute of a target item. Seats never share a map, so scores are absolute and comparable across episodes. Replays record every program, its output, and an entity snapshot per step, rendered by a static wasm viewer.

fast.description: FLE fast mode: actions (movement, crafting, harvesting) resolve instantly rather than being tick-driven.

task.description: FLE task key: open_play (score = production score) or an FLE lab-play throughput task key such as iron_plate_throughput, iron_gear_wheel_throughput, copper_plate_throughput, stone_furnace_throughput (score = achieved items/minute of the target item, measured with FLE's holdout verification at the end).

tokens.description: One connection token per player seat, indexed by seat slot. Injected by the runner; never authored.

players.description: One player display-name object per seat, indexed by seat slot. Each seat plays its own Factorio server.

game_speed.description: Factorio game.speed while the episode runs (FLE default 10).

num_agents.description: Number of agent seats; must equal the player slot count. Used by the platform ladder service for seating; ignored by the game server.

strike_limit.description: Consecutive noop steps that mark a seat dead (its remaining steps are forfeited).

step_deadline_seconds.description: Seconds a policy has to reply with a program after receiving an observation; late/missing/malformed replies forfeit the step (noop) and count one strike.

program_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock cap for executing one program against Factorio; a program that exceeds it is interrupted with an error (not a strike).

wall_clock_budget_seconds.description: Engine wall-clock hard stop: the episode ends itself with end_reason wall_clock (scores as of that moment, artifacts written) once this much real time has elapsed. Default 0.85 x episode_timeout_minutes x 60 - always under the platform container kill, which would lose results and replay.

player_connect_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for a seat to connect before its loop starts anyway (it then noops until it connects or strikes out); never-connected seats are reported to COGAME_PLAYER_FAILURE_URI.

names.description: One player name per seat, in seat-slot order.

scores.description: One scalar score per seat: FLE production score (open_play) or achieved items/minute (throughput tasks). Absolute, higher is better.

task_key.description: The FLE task key the episode played.

dead_seats.description: Per-seat strike-rule dead flag at episode end.

end_reason.description: Why the episode ended: every seat finished its steps or struck out (steps_cap), the engine's wall-clock budget expired (wall_clock), or a Factorio/FLE fault ended play early (sim_fault: scores as of the fault, partial replay).

noop_steps.description: Steps forfeited to noop (late, missing, malformed, wrong-step reply), per seat.

error_steps.description: Executed programs that raised or timed out, per seat.

final_ticks.description: FLE elapsed game ticks per seat at episode end.

noop_causes.description: Per-seat noop cause counters. timeout/malformed/disconnected/host_error partition noop_steps; wrong_step counts mis-addressed reply messages (such a step also counts as timeout).

throughputs.description: Achieved items/minute of the task's target item per seat (throughput tasks), null for open_play.

production_scores.description: FLE production score per seat at episode end, regardless of task.

wall_clock_seconds.description: Real seconds from episode start to end.

player.name: burner baseline
player.description: Scripted baseline: burner mining drills on the iron and coal patches feeding stone furnaces, refuelled every few steps. Image placeholder is replaced at deploy time.

player.name: handcraft baseline
player.description: Scripted baseline: hand-mines ore and smelts it in hand-placed stone furnaces; no automation.

player.name: idle baseline
player.description: Scripted baseline: replies with a no-op program every step (score floor).

variants.name: Open play (2 seats)
variants.description: Two seats on separate FLE lab maps, 30 programs each; score = FLE production score.

variants.name: Iron plate throughput (2 seats)
variants.description: FLE lab-play task iron_plate_throughput: build a factory producing iron plates; score = items/minute achieved at the end (FLE quota is 16/min).
